title: Funding a feasibility study for East Maui Water Authority
summary: On September 24, 2024, the committee voted eight ayes, with one member excused, to file Bills 122 and 134 (2024), setting both aside. Bill 122 was a budget change for an East Maui Water Authority study, referred to the budget committee in August. The draft contract covered analysis of a possible purchase of the East Maui irrigation system.
